[Item 1: Travel to Beijing for project seminar]
Step 1: Check — Business trip report form is completed, signed by unit head, and affixed with department seal. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Personnel classification: professor (bureau-director level equivalent). First-class train seat is allowed for this level under Rule 7(2). Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Accommodation: Beijing bureau-director standard is 650 RMB/night; actual rate 600 RMB/night is within limit per Appendix 1. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Compute — Meal allowance: 3 calendar days at 100 RMB/day (other regions) equals 300 RMB; claimed amount matches. Result: 300.
Step 5: Check — City transportation: reimbursed against actual receipts at 180 RMB, which is reasonable and allowed under Rule 7(9). Result: PASS.
Step 6: Check — Attendance at a project seminar: under Rule 7(5), a conference or training notice is required as supporting material. No such notice is provided in the case. Result: FAIL.
Step 7: Conclusion — Missing essential supporting material (conference notice) as required by Rule 7(5) and Rule 3(3). Result: Not Reimbursable.

[Item 2: Routine office supplies for organizing materials]
Step 1: Check — Amount does not reach fixed asset threshold (under 1000 RMB per item or not meeting service-life criteria), so Rule 16 does not apply. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Item does not fall within the Asset Management Office's review scope for purchased inventory, so no confirmation form needed per Rule 6(2). Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Seller provided a goods list with the invoice, satisfying the requirement of Rule 6(2) for items not in review scope. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — No books or printing expenses involved, so sub-rules 6(3), 6(4), 6(5), 6(6) are not triggered. No further special requirements. Result: PASS.
Step 5: Check — Standard reimbursement materials (reservation form, signed invoices) are assumed present as the case states he organized documents; no indication of missing signatures. Result: PASS.
Step 6: Conclusion — All apparent requirements for routine office supplies are met. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 1: Large centrifuge maintenance fees]
Step 1: Check — whether the maintenance fee reimbursement has been applied for through the Asset Management Office system. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — whether the 'Fudan University Fixed Asset Maintenance Application Form' has been printed, signed by relevant personnel, and affixed with the official seal of the unit. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — whether the original invoice for the maintenance service is attached. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Conclusion — all requirements of the primary and supplementary rules are satisfied. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 2: Routine office supplies (stationery, newspapers, magazines)]
Step 1: Check — whether the supplies are routine office expenses (office stationery, newspapers, magazines) and below the fixed asset threshold. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — whether the supplies fall within the Asset Management Office's review scope for purchased inventory; they do not. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — whether the seller provided a goods list with the invoice (Rule 6(2) requires a goods list or online transaction record). Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — whether any special conditions for books or printing materials apply; newspapers and magazines are not books/material requiring additional contracts. Result: PASS.
Step 5: Conclusion — all requirements of the primary and supplementary rules are satisfied. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 1: Engineering Renovation Settlement]
Step 1: Check — Amount exceeds RMB 100,000, triggering strict approval requirements under Rule 14. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Original approval form with signatures of Capital Construction Office head and vice president in charge is complete. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — This is final settlement payment upon project completion; cost review opinion and audit filing form are attached. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Compute — Payment amount is controlled according to contract and project progress, no overpayment. Result: PASS.
Step 5: Check — Contract for single payment ≥30,000 is implied as payment is controlled per contract; no violation. Result: PASS.
Step 6: Check — Large cash fund form (>50,000) not required as payment method is not indicated as cash; assumed bank transfer. Result: PASS.
Step 7: Conclusion — All conditions for engineering renovation reimbursement are met. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 2: Domestic Official Hospitality]
Step 1: Check — One-matter-one-settlement method is used. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Working meal standard ≤100 per person per day (100 per day is within limit). Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Formal banquet standard ≤150 per person per occasion (150 is within limit). Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — Accompanying staff limit: 9 visitors, 3 accompanying ≤3 allowed (exactly 3, within limit). Result: PASS.
Step 5: Check — Required documents: official letter from visiting institution or 'Fudan University Domestic Official Hospitality Approval Form' is missing (case states 'either the official letter or the approval form was missing'). Result: FAIL.
Step 6: Conclusion — Missing a critical required document renders the expense non-compliant. Result: Not Reimbursable.

[Item 3: Master's Dissertation Defense Remuneration]
Step 1: Check — Number of reviewers: 3, within allowed range 2-3. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Compute — Reviewer fee: 300 per person, within allowed range 200-300. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Number of defense committee members: 5, within allowed range 3-5. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Compute — Committee fee: 300 per person, within allowed range 200-300. Result: PASS.
Step 5: Check — Defense secretary: 1, fee 100, matches standard of 100. Result: PASS.
Step 6: Conclusion — All fee amounts and headcounts comply with Rule 13(1). Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 4: Academician Lecture Remuneration]
Step 1: Check — Lecturer is an academician, subject to 1500 per class hour limit. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Compute — Claimed fee: 1400 per class hour; ≤1500 per class hour limit. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Total class hours: 4, which is the maximum allowed per half day. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Conclusion — Lecture fee and hours comply with Rule 13(2). Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 5: Expert Consulting Remuneration (Communication)]
Step 1: Check — Consulting type: remote/communication, subject to written/remote consultation standard. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Compute — Fee per project: 80. This falls within the senior range (60-100) and other personnel range (40-80). Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — No indication of missing materials or approvals for this consulting item. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Conclusion — Fee is within acceptable range; no compliance issues identified. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 1: Travel expenses for attending academic annual meeting]
Step 1: Check — Business Trip Report Form is provided with signature and official seal. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Inter-city transportation receipts and lodging invoice are provided. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Meal subsidy claimed (3 days × RMB 100 = RMB 300) matches standard in Rule 7(8). Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — City transportation expenses (RMB 180) are reimbursed on actual basis; no explicit mention of invoices attached. Result: FAIL.
Step 5: Check — Conference notice for the attended meeting is required under Rule 7(5); not mentioned in case. Result: FAIL.
Step 6: Check — Accommodation standard (RMB 600/night) cannot be verified because destination is not specified; unknown whether within Appendix 1 limits. Result: FAIL.
Step 7: Conclusion — Missing essential materials (city transportation invoices, conference notice) and insufficient information on accommodation standard. Result: Not Reimbursable.

[Item 2: Conference organization expenses (research fund domestic business conference)]
Step 1: Check — Conference is funded by research project funds, so Rule 9(1)1 applies. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Duration is 2 days, within the 2-day limit for domestic business conferences per Rule 9(7). Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Comprehensive quota for domestic business conferences under research funds: accommodation 500, meals 150, other expenses 100, total 750 (RMB/person/day). Result: PASS.
Step 4: Compute — Budgeted total per person per day: accommodation 500 + meals 150 + other expenses 110 = 760 (RMB/person/day). Result: 760.
Step 5: Compute — Excess per person per day: 760 - 750 = 10 (RMB/person/day). Result: 10.
Step 6: Compute — Total excess for 100 participants over 2 days: 100 × 2 × 10 = 2,000 RMB. Result: 2000.
Step 7: Check — Required materials (notice, agenda, budget form, expense details, sign-in sheet, service contract) are all attached. Result: PASS.
Step 8: Conclusion — Budget exceeds the comprehensive quota by 10 RMB/person/day; the overrun portion is not reimbursable. Result: Partially Reimbursable.

[Item 3: Office stationery purchase with artificial invoice splitting]
Step 1: Check — Purchase is office stationery, which is a routine office supply under Rule 6(1). Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Seller provided a sales list together with the invoice. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Invoice amounts were artificially split to avoid review requirement (explicitly stated in case). Result: FAIL.
Step 4: Check — Rule 6(5) explicitly prohibits artificial splitting of invoice amounts; Rule 4(8) considers incomplete procedures as a violation. Result: FAIL.
Step 5: Conclusion — Artificial splitting is a clear policy violation; the purchase is not reimbursable. Result: Not Reimbursable.

[Item 4: Office stationery and computer accessories purchase]
Step 1: Check — Purchase includes office stationery (okay with sales list per Rule 6(2)). Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Purchase includes computer accessories; per Rule 6(2), if they fall within the Asset Management Office review scope, a 'Fudan University Purchased Inventory Review Result Confirmation Form' is required. Result: FAIL.
Step 3: Check — Sales list is provided, but no confirmation form from Asset Management Office is mentioned. Result: FAIL.
Step 4: Conclusion — Missing required Asset Management Office approval for computer accessories; the entire purchase is not reimbursable as it cannot be separated without specification. Result: Not Reimbursable.

[Item 1: Teaching Methodology Training Expenses]
Step 1: Check — Expense type identification: the submitted costs are for a training activity, falling under Rule 10. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Comprehensive quota compliance: the training is 20 days, reported under bureau-director-level standard (RMB 650 per person per day). The total of lodging, meal, venue, materials, transportation, and other expenses is RMB 18,720, which includes lecturer fees. The number of trainees is not provided, so per-person per-day cost cannot be calculated. Result: FAIL.
Step 3: Check — Separation of instructor fees: Rule 10(4) requires instructor fees to be calculated separately and not included in the comprehensive quota. The comprehensive quota total of RMB 18,720 explicitly includes lecturer fees of RMB 2,500, violating this rule. Result: FAIL.
Step 4: Check — Instructor's accommodation, meals, and transportation: lodging RMB 600, meals RMB 200, transportation RMB 900. The number of days for the instructor is unknown, making it impossible to verify compliance with the bureau-director-level standard (accommodation ≤RMB 400/day, meals ≤RMB 150/day). Result: FAIL.
Step 5: Check — Required documents: the 'Fudan University Detailed List of Training Expense Expenditures', trainee list, and service provider invoices are present. Signatures and approvals are not explicitly mentioned but assumed part of 'complete' documents. Result: PASS.
Step 6: Conclusion — Due to improper inclusion of lecturer fees in the comprehensive quota and lack of trainee count and instructor trip details to verify quota adherence, the item cannot be approved as submitted. Result: Not Reimbursable.

[Item 2: Travel Expenses for Simultaneous Trip]
Step 1: Check — Are inter-city transportation receipts and lodging invoice provided? Yes, both are present. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Is the 'Fudan University Business Trip Report Form' attached? The case explicitly states it is not attached. Result: FAIL.
Step 3: Check — Are business trip approval and itinerary materials attached? The case states they are not attached. Result: FAIL.
Step 4: Check — Is the responsible person's signature and official seal present on receipts? Yes, they are complete. Result: PASS.
Step 5: Conclusion — An essential document (Business Trip Report Form) required by Rule 7(1) is missing, making the reimbursement submission incomplete. Result: Not Reimbursable.

[Item 3: Lecture and Consulting Remuneration]
Step 1: Check — Lecture fee rate: 8 class hours at RMB 500 per class hour totals RMB 4,000. The lecturer is reported under division-level and lower personnel category. For associate senior titles, the limit is ≤RMB 500 per class hour. Title not specified, but rate is within the associate senior boundary. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Maximum class hours per half day: Rule 13(2) limits to 4 class hours per half day. 8 class hours could span 2 half-days, which is acceptable. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Consulting fee rate: 2 days at RMB 800 per day totals RMB 1,600. For senior professional titles, the on-site consultation rate is RMB 500–800 per day for the first two days. RMB 800 is within the upper bound. However, the case classifies this under division-level and lower personnel, which might conflict with the senior title assumption. The actual title of the recipient is not provided. Result: PENDING.
Step 4: Check — Remuneration declaration procedures: no information is given about whether the declaration was submitted through the system, external personnel information was maintained, or proper signatures were obtained as per Rule 12. Result: FAIL.
Step 5: Conclusion — Insufficient information on the recipients' titles and declaration procedures makes it impossible to confirm full compliance with Rules 13 and 12. Result: Pending.

[Item 4: Office Supplies and Drinking Water]
Step 1: Check — Are the items within the scope of office expenses? Office stationery and drinking water are listed as routine supplies in Rule 6(1). Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Is a goods list provided? The seller provided a sales list together with the invoice, satisfying Rule 6(2) for office supplies not requiring asset review. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Are invoice signatures (project PI and handling staff) present? The case does not mention invoices being signed. However, the submission is made for review and no deficiency is noted for this item, so signatures are assumed to be present. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Conclusion — All evident requirements for office expense reimbursement are met. No violations or missing materials are identified. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 1: Family Visit Travel Expense]
Step 1: Check — the expense is identified as a family visit by an unmarried employee visiting parents. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — the claimed amount of RMB 700 is within the one round-trip per year allowance. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — the family visit application form is included in the materials. Result: FAIL.
Step 4: Conclusion — missing required family visit application form. Result: Not Reimbursable.

[Item 2: Business Travel Expense for Conference and Reviewer Duties]
Step 1: Check — the Fudan University Business Trip Report Form is included. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — intercity transportation class (first-class train) is allowed for a professor (bureau-director level). Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — the conference uniformly arranged lodging and meals, so separate lodging reimbursement is not allowed. Result: FAIL.
Step 4: Check — meal subsidy claimed for 3 days (RMB 300) includes the conference day when meals were provided; meal allowance should not be paid during the conference period per Rule 7(5). Result: FAIL.
Step 5: Check — city transportation allowance claimed for 3 days (RMB 240) is affected by the conference providing accommodation; no explanation for exception per Rule 7(6) is provided. Result: FAIL.
Step 6: Conclusion — multiple violations: improper lodging, meal subsidy, and city transportation claims. Result: Not Reimbursable.

[Item 3: Doctoral Dissertation Defense Remuneration]
Step 1: Check — the defense fee amount is specified in the materials. Result: FAIL.
Step 2: Check — the defense fee is within the standard range (RMB 300-500 per reviewer). Result: FAIL.
Step 3: Conclusion — missing amount and insufficient information to verify compliance. Result: Not Reimbursable.

[Item 4: Lecture Fee Remuneration]
Step 1: Check — the lecture fee amount is specified: RMB 900 per class hour for 4 hours = RMB 3,600. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — the lecture fee is within the standard (full senior ≤ RMB 1,000 per class hour). Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — the class hours are within the maximum allowed (4 class hours per half day). Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — remuneration declaration procedures are followed (materials included). Result: PASS.
Step 5: Conclusion — all requirements are met. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 1: Overseas travel from Germany (official overseas travel)]
Step 1: Check — whether the foreign affairs approval document and the original overseas expense statement are attached. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — whether all overseas expenses are submitted in a single consolidated batch. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — whether the traveler's rank (bureau-director-level) and the chosen airfare class (first-class) comply with the standard under Rule 7(2) (economy class). Result: FAIL.
Step 4: Check — whether a written explanation of special circumstances and project principal investigator approval were provided for the higher class airfare. Result: FAIL.
Step 5: Conclusion — airfare portion exceeds standard and lacks required justification; other expenses (registration fee, living allowance, incidental expenses, transportation) appear compliant. Only the economy-class equivalent of the airfare is reimbursable. Result: Partially Reimbursable.

[Item 2: Domestic management conference (organized by the university, non-research funds)]
Step 1: Check — whether the conference type is correctly identified as a domestic management conference (non-research funds). Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — whether the conference duration (1 day) complies with the limit (max 1 day for management conferences per Rule 9(7)). Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — whether required supporting materials (notice, agenda, budget form, expense details, sign-in sheet, service contract/agreement) are complete. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Compute — the comprehensive quota standard for a domestic management conference (non-research funds): accommodation 340 + meals 130 + other expenses 80 = 550 RMB per person per day. Actual total: 340 + 130 + 90 = 560 RMB per person per day. Result: Excess = 10 per person per day.
Step 5: Check — whether the total actual cost per person exceeds the comprehensive quota (550). The excess of 10 is not allowed under quota control, even though amounts may be adjusted among themselves, the total must not exceed the quota. Result: FAIL.
Step 6: Conclusion — the conference expenses are otherwise compliant, but the total cost exceeds the comprehensive quota by 10 per person per day. The excess portion is not reimbursable. Result: Partially Reimbursable.

[Item 3: Application software purchase (intangible asset)]
Step 1: Check — whether the application software meets the intangible asset criteria (value >= 2000 and not indispensable hardware component). The case implies it qualifies. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — whether the 'Fudan University Asset Reimbursement Form (Intangible Assets)' (second copy) is attached. The case states it is fully attached. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — whether other basic materials (original invoice, signatures) are likely present (no issues mentioned). Result: PASS.
Step 4: Conclusion — all required materials and procedures for intangible asset reimbursement are satisfied. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 4: Office stationery and office furniture (small purchase)]
Step 1: Check — whether the office stationery (low-value consumable) is covered by a goods list. The seller provided a sales list together with the invoice. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — whether the office furniture unit price exceeds the fixed asset threshold (RMB 1000). The case does not specify the amount, so it is unknown. Result: FAIL (insufficient information).
Step 3: Check — if the furniture is a fixed asset, whether the 'Fudan University Asset Reimbursement Form' from the Asset Management Office is attached. Not mentioned. Result: FAIL (insufficient information).
Step 4: Conclusion — the office stationery part appears compliant, but the office furniture portion requires further information to determine if it should be treated as a fixed asset. The item is therefore pending confirmation. Result: Pending.

[Item 1: Final settlement payment for teaching building restroom renovation project]

Step 2: Check — Original approval form (including large cash fund elements) with all required signatures and seals complete. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Final settlement: original cost review opinion and filing form attached. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — Payment amount controlled according to contract and project progress, no overpayment. Result: PASS.
Step 5: Check — Signed payment contract attached (Rule 3(4) requires for single payment ≥ RMB 30,000). Result: FAIL.
Step 6: Conclusion — Missing essential material: signed payment contract. Result: Not Reimbursable.

Step 6: Conclusion — All requirements met. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 3: Purchase of office stationery and office furniture]
Step 1: Check — Office stationery and office furniture are routine office supplies. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Seller provided a sales list together with the invoice, meeting Rule 6(2) for items not within asset review scope. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — If any office furniture unit price > RMB 1,000, it would require fixed asset registration (Rule 16), but no price information given; purchase described as 'small', assume low value. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — Signatures on invoice and reservation form (Rule 3) assumed present as submitted together. Result: PASS.
Step 5: Conclusion — Requirements appear satisfied based on provided information. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 4: Purchase of office stationery and cleaning supplies (online)]
Step 1: Check — Office stationery and cleaning supplies are routine office supplies. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Online shopping transaction detail record retained, meeting Rule 6(2) requirement. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Signatures and reservation form assumed present. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Conclusion — Requirements satisfied. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 1: NMR Instrument Maintenance Fee]

Step 2: Check — whether the Fudan University Fixed Asset Maintenance Application Form was printed with relevant signatures and official seal. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — whether the original maintenance service invoice is complete. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Conclusion — The prerequisite of submitting an application through the Asset Management Office system before reimbursement was not met. Despite having the printed form and invoice, the required procedure was omitted, making this item not reimbursable. Result: Not Reimbursable.

[Item 2: Engineer's Inter-city Transportation and Lodging]
Step 1: Check — whether the Fudan University Business Trip Report Form was completed with responsible person's signature and official seal. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — whether the project leader confirmed the inter-city transportation and lodging standards. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — whether the relevant receipts for transportation and lodging are provided. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — whether any meal allowance or lump-sum local transportation allowance is claimed for the external engineer. Result: PASS.
Step 5: Conclusion — All requirements for reimbursing travel expenses of invited external personnel are satisfied. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 3: Domestic Official Hospitality (Working Meal and Formal Banquet)]
Step 1: Check — whether the official letter from the visiting institution, the Fudan University Domestic Official Hospitality List, and the Fudan University Domestic Official Hospitality Approval Form are complete. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — whether accommodation expenses are claimed. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Compute — formal banquet standard: RMB 150 per person per occasion. Result: 150.
Step 4: Check — whether the formal banquet standard (RMB 150) does not exceed the allowed one working meal limit (RMB 150 per person). Result: PASS.
Step 5: Compute — working meal standard: RMB 120 per person per day. Result: 120.
Step 6: Check — whether the working meal standard (RMB 120 per person per day) exceeds the ordinary meal standard (RMB 100 per person per day). Result: FAIL.
Step 7: Conclusion — The working meal at RMB 120 per person per day exceeds the allowed ordinary meal standard of RMB 100 per person per day. Only the formal banquet (within the one working meal limit) is compliant. Therefore, the hospitality expense is partially reimbursable, with the excess portion of the working meal excluded. Result: Partially Reimbursable.

[Item 4: Office Stationery and Computer Accessories]
Step 1: Check — whether the seller provided a sales list with the invoice. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — whether the purchased items (computer accessories) fall within the Asset Management Office review scope for purchased inventory. Result: Unknown.
Step 3: Check — if the items are within the review scope, whether the Fudan University Purchased Inventory Review Result Confirmation Form is attached. Result: FAIL.
Step 4: Check — if the items are not within the review scope, whether a goods list is attached (office supplies and cleaning supplies do not require the confirmation form; a sales list suffices). Result: PASS.
Step 5: Conclusion — The office stationery portion appears compliant, but for the computer accessories it is unclear whether the Asset Management Office confirmation form is required. Without this information, the reimbursement cannot be fully approved. Further verification is needed. Result: Pending.

[Item 1: Visitor reception expenses (foreign guests)]
Step 1: Check — Foreign affairs filing completed and Accounting Report submitted. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Accommodation in four-star hotel for other-rank guests. Result: PASS.

Step 4: Check — Banquet at RMB 280 per person per occasion (limit RMB 300 for bureau-director-level or below per Appendix 3). Result: PASS.
Step 5: Check — Gifts for other personnel are small commemorative gifts (no explicit limit; assumed reasonable per Appendix 3). Result: PASS.
Step 6: Check — Meal allowance subsidy for staff at RMB 50 per person per occasion (matches meal-delay subsidy in Appendix 3). Result: PASS.
Step 7: Check — Local transportation claimed; no indication whether actual invoices are attached or lump-sum method used (Article 7(11) prohibits lump-sum local transportation allowance for external personnel). Result: FAIL.
Step 8: Conclusion — Due to missing detail on local transportation method (invoices vs. lump sum), full compliance cannot be confirmed. Result: Pending.

[Item 2: Conference organization expenses (research funds)]
Step 1: Check — Conference funded by research project funds, so use domestic business conference standards (total 750, accommodation 500, meals 150, other 100 per person per day). Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Duration is 2 days; domestic business conferences shall not exceed 2 days (Article 9(7)). Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Lodging uniformly arranged, meals not uniformly arranged. Adjusted quota = total minus meal component = 750 - 150 = 600 per person per day. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Compute — Remaining conference expenses per person per day reported as RMB 650. Result: 650.
Step 5: Check — RMB 650 exceeds the adjusted comprehensive quota of RMB 600; no breakdown provided to identify whether the excess comes from items outside the quota (e.g., invited expert travel, interpreter fees, etc.) allowed by Article 9(1). Result: FAIL.
Step 6: Conclusion — Without a detailed breakdown of the remaining expenses, it is impossible to verify compliance with the quota or exclusions. Result: Pending.

[Item 3: Small purchases (office stationery and computer accessories)]
Step 1: Check — Items are office stationery and computer accessories, which are typical office expenses (Article 6(1)). Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — Seller provided a sales list with the invoice; this meets Article 6(2) for office supplies not within the Asset Management Office's review scope. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — Computer accessories may be within the Asset Management Office's review scope for purchased inventory; no 'Fudan University Purchased Inventory Review Result Confirmation Form' is mentioned (Article 6(2) and Article 16(3)). Result: FAIL.
Step 4: Conclusion — Missing information on whether computer accessories require asset registration or inventory review form; cannot confirm full compliance. Result: Pending.

Step 1: Check — whether the expert's professional title (senior or other) is specified to determine applicable fee range. Result: FAIL.

Step 1: Check — whether the 'Fudan University Detailed List of Training Expense Expenditures' is present. Result: PASS.

[Item 3: Travel expenses related to training activity]
Step 1: Check — whether the 'Fudan University Business Trip Report Form' is present. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — whether transportation and accommodation receipts are complete. Result: PASS.
Step 3: Check — whether signatures of unit head and official seal are present. Result: PASS.
Step 4: Check — whether any indication of missing approvals or non-compliance with meal allowance rules (e.g., meals provided during training) is present in case. Result: PASS (no issues mentioned).
Step 5: Conclusion — all described conditions for travel expense reimbursement are met. Result: Fully Reimbursable.

[Item 4: Office stationery, newspapers, and magazines]
Step 1: Check — whether an original supporting invoice is present. Result: PASS.
Step 2: Check — whether a goods list or online purchase detail is attached (seller provided sales list). Result: PASS.
